in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من ث ل ك، يعني المتكلم أو الكثير الكلام

in_urdu.name: ثالکا
in_urdu.meaning: ث ل ک سے مشتق، یعنی بولنے والا یا زیادہ بولنے والا

In Islamic culture, this name can be interpreted as a reminder of the blessings and gifts that Allah individually bestows upon each of us at the right time and in the right place. It encourages us to be patient and trusting in Allah's timing.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Thalika carries a deeper spiritual significance for Muslims. It is a reminder of the blessings and rewards that Allah grant us in our lives. The name Thalika comes from the Arabic word 'thalika' which means 'this' and 'such', symbolizing that everything we have is a reward from Allah, given to us at the right time and place. It serves as a constant reminder of the role of gratitude and trust in our relationship with Allah, and encourages us to seek His blessings and rewards in all aspects of our lives.
